purpose: Record the four remaining Primary Domain blockers as explicit fail-closed terminal HOLD decisions rather than leaving them in an undifferentiated repair backlog.
policy: A Primary Domain must identify one exact ACTIVE L2 owner; title proximity or partial overlap is insufficient.
When the complete current 30-object ACTIVE L2 registry contains no unique owner for the full current body semantics, the object remains HOLD rather than being assigned to a nearest-looking domain.
A HOLD is reopened only when the Domain Registry changes materially or an explicit authority decision resolves ownership.
No Notion, D1, classification, body, structural hierarchy or typed relation mutation is authorized by this file.

holds.reason: The complete current body treats urban regeneration as a compound spatial and institutional process spanning property/rights, displacement, local economy, publicness/participation, environmental performance and long-term governance. The current ACTIVE L2 registry has no Urbanism, Urban Regeneration or equivalent city-scale owner. Participatory & Collaborative Design, Sustainable Design, Pre-design & Briefing and Design Governance & Quality each cover only a subset.
holds.reopenCondition: Create/rename an ACTIVE L2 that explicitly owns urban regeneration/city-scale transformation, or issue an explicit authority decision assigning this compound subject to an existing L2.

holds.reason: The body explicitly declares a general-design master navigation surface spanning Research & Strategy, Brand & Visual, Product & Experience, Human Factors, Material & CMF, Digital & Interaction, Media/Information/Motion, Service/Governance, Theory/History/Culture and Methods & Design Intelligence. No single ACTIVE L2 can own this without falsifying scope. Runtime authority also already states the old 20｜General Design Knowledge navigation surface is not default structural-routing authority.
holds.reopenCondition: Resolve the non-authoritative navigation/index disposition explicitly; do not promote it to L1 structural authority or attach it to an arbitrary L2.

holds.reason: The healthcare typology body owns care mission/pathway, patient/staff/material states, clinical operations, infection/environmental control, equipment/MEP, emergency/resilience and standards/validation. The current ACTIVE L2 registry has no Healthcare or Building Typology domain; Architectural Form Theory, Pre-design, MEP, Standards and Life Safety are only partial owners.
holds.reopenCondition: Add an ACTIVE L2 that owns healthcare/building typology, or issue an explicit authority decision defining which current L2 owns multidisciplinary building-typology frameworks.

holds.reason: The body spans actors/program, operating model, frontstage/backstage logistics, capacity/economics, cultural/social context, rights, risk and G9 feedback. Its own Service Design section says Service Design is called conditionally for cross-touchpoint service, so Service Design is an adjacent route rather than the unique owner; Pre-design & Briefing also covers only part of the lifecycle/operations/social subject.
holds.reopenCondition: Clarify an ACTIVE L2 owner for architectural program/operations/social systems, or issue an explicit cross-domain ownership rule that assigns these routing maps without collapsing their scope.
